title: La cintura geográfica: El Tapón del Darién y los dos mares
goal: Examine Panama's isthmian geography, geological formation, and the wild barrier of the Darién Gap using advanced geographical prose.
grammar: Geografía del istmo panameño y el tapón del Darién

sections.title: Unit 8: Panama — Lesson 1
body: Welcome to lesson 1 of Unit 8 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Panama: The Interoceanic Crossroads, Global Commerce & Afro-Antillean Identity.
In this lesson, we study la cintura geográfica: el tapón del darién y los dos mares, evaluating Panama's physical geography, sovereignty struggles, cultural pluralism, and economic paradoxes.

items: Examine Panama's isthmian geography, geological formation, and the wild barrier of the Darién Gap using advanced geographical prose.
Master the lexicon and discourse of geografia-istmo-selva-darien.
